values.note: Online through the city's ResNexus page or at 417-334-2915. The rates page names a 2-night minimum only for lakefront and premium pull-thrus, but the booking engine turned every one-night search (a December, January and June Tuesday) into 2 nights on every class ('ENJOY FOR 2 NIGHTS OR MORE'). First night charged as a non-refundable deposit; you book a site type, a specific site costs extra. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: City of Branson RV park on Lake Taneycomo beside Branson Landing, a walk from Historic Downtown Branson (free trolley). The lakefront pull-thrus face the water across the park's own road and a narrow bank with fishing docks. --Claude
summary: City pages + ResNexus: $40 (Jan snowbird) / $55 (Dec) / $64 (Jun 2027) back-in to $99 deluxe patio, open all year, 50A full hookups, pull-thrus to 90 ft, engine enforces 2 nights on every class; GS + veterans 10%. Waterfront lead lakefront -> lakeview (own road between the front row and the bank). Pin is on the bridge approach ~170 m NE.
flags: WATERFRONT lead lakefront -> lakeview: Esri imagery (36.6355,-93.2168, 180 m frame) shows the front 'Lakefront Pull Through' row backing onto the campground's own paved road, then a ~10-15 m sand/riprap bank with the fishing docks, then Lake Taneycomo (a dammed reach of the White River, ~250 m wide). The operator sells them as lakefront ('Pull in facing water'), but under the 2026-11-01 ruling the campground's own road between pads and water blocks on-water: lakeview at best, and the view is open.

MINIMUM STAY: the ResNexus engine forced a 2-night stay on all 11 site classes for one-night searches on Tue 2026-12-08, Tue 2027-01-12 and Tue 2027-06-08, although the rates page marks only the lakefront and premium pull-thrus '(2-night minimum)'. Recorded as a standing 2-night minimum (local entry; 2 nights is within the 'keep if marked' rule).
